rows.jyutping: jung6 gou1 naan4 dou6 dung6 zok3
rows.note: Use this all-purpose spoken choice for a physically difficult or athletic move, especially in sports.

example.english: They landed acrobatically with a high-difficulty move and still stood firmly.
example.traditional: 佢喺體操比賽入面用高難度動作落地，仲企得好穩。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai2 tai2 cou1 bei2 coi3 jap6 min6 jung6 gou1 naan4 dou6 dung6 zok3 lok6 dei6 zung6 kei5 dak1 hou2 wan2

rows.jyutping: hou2 ci5 zou6 zaap6 gei6 gam3
rows.note: Use this when the action visibly resembles an acrobatic performance rather than merely being difficult.

example.english: He jumped down acrobatically, as if he were performing acrobatics, and it scared me.
example.traditional: 佢由牆上跳落嚟，好似做雜技咁，睇到我心都離埋。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jau4 coeng4 soeng5 tiu3 lok6 lai4 hou2 ci5 zou6 zaap6 gei6 gam3 tai2 dou2 ngo5 sam1 dou1 lei4 maai4
